paragraphs: RunwayStats sells an airport traffic tracking system built on a receiver placed on the airfield and a dashboard, so that every aircraft touching the airport is counted, identified, and stored. Every takeoff, landing, touch and go, go around, helicopter operation, and airspace transition at the airport is detected automatically and logged in real time. Each logged operation carries the time, registration, callsign, runway used, weather conditions, aircraft make and model, and owner, and the data can be filtered, searched, and downloaded to CSV.

Reports run for any day, month, or year on demand or on a schedule, with delivery to an inbox, a board, or a state DOT. Noise complaints are handled by a complaint management add on that logs, investigates, and tracks each complaint through resolution. A separate add on covers commercial operations, tracking scheduled, estimated, and actual times for arrivals and departures along with on-time performance, gate usage, and taxi times.

Multiple Airports is built for engineering firms, counties, port authorities, and airport groups with more than one airport under their wing. Subscriptions are sold in Essentials and Platinum tiers, and features from any tier can be mixed into one package.

quote.text: The Clearest View Of Your Airport's Activity
